subject: executor: try to optimize index lookup query may send too many cop task (#53855)
summary: Reviewed the single-file change in `pkg/executor/distsql.go` (IndexLookUpExecutor): it computes a larger initial `indexWorker.batchSize` for non-paging cases using index-side `StatsCount()` to reduce task/RPC overhead, while keeping the limit/paging case using the small initial batch size, and updates paging min/max sizing to track the computed batch size. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, privilege/visibility, transaction/session, or concurrency issues found in the touched executor path. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` and saw follow-up refactoring around the batch-size helper, but no later fix suggesting a correctness regression from this commit.
